resources.string:
1. On your computer, configure OpenClaw with the dedicated liveabit agent and its protected webhook. Use the setup instructions supplied with this build.

2. Import or paste the liveabit OpenClaw connection setup here. It supplies the /hooks/agent address and its hook token. Do not use the OpenClaw dashboard login token.

3. Choose apps, enable usage access, and tap Start sharing. Your phone talks directly to OpenClaw. No receiver server is needed.

For Wi-Fi, keep both devices on the same local network and use the computer’s network address. For USB, keep OpenClaw local and run the matching adb reverse command from the project instructions.

OpenClaw acceptance means an agent run was started. Check its liveabit sessions for the result; the app does not claim that processing finished.

1. Keep your phone and computer on the same local network.

2. On the computer, open PowerShell in the liveabit project folder and run:
.\scripts\start-activity-receiver.ps1

3. Open http://127.0.0.1:8765/ on the computer. Connect with the token from artifacts/activity-receiver/connection.json. Select Phone on Wi-Fi and copy or download that setup.

4. Transfer the setup to this phone and import or paste it here. Choose apps, enable usage access, then tap Start sharing.

The address should be your computer’s local-network address followed by :8765/events. A USB address, 127.0.0.1, will not reach the computer over Wi-Fi. Allow the receiver on the computer’s private network if Windows Firewall asks.

No USB cable is needed. Keep the receiver window open; Ctrl+C stops it. If you chose another port, use it instead of 8765.

1. On the computer, open PowerShell in the liveabit project folder and run:
.\scripts\start-activity-receiver.ps1 -LocalOnly

2. On this phone, enable Developer options and USB debugging. Connect it by USB and accept its debugging prompt.

3. In a second PowerShell window on the computer, run:
.\artifacts\android-sdk\platform-tools\adb.exe -d reverse tcp:8765 tcp:8765

4. In the receiver dashboard, connect with its token and select Phone connected by USB. Import or paste that setup here, choose apps, then tap Start sharing.

USB setup uses http://127.0.0.1:8765/events. Repeat the reverse command after reconnecting the cable. If you chose another port, use it in both parts of the command.
This changes the receiver, key or selected apps. Pending events to clear: %1$d. Cancel to keep the current sharing setup, or switch and clear them.
